title: refactor(service-ai): auth metadata, user context, ownership, enhanced tool-call loop
body:
Adds route-level auth/permissions declarations, user context propagation, conversation ownership enforcement, and improved tool-call orchestration with error handling and streaming support.

### Route auth/permissions metadata

- `RouteDefinition` gains `auth?: boolean` and `permissions?: string[]`
- All routes declare explicit permission scopes: `ai:chat`, `ai:complete`, `ai:read`, `ai:conversations`, `ai:agents`

### User context on RouteRequest

- New `RouteUserContext` type (`userId`, `displayName`, `roles`, `permissions`)
- `RouteRequest.user` populated by auth middleware upstream

### Conversation ownership

- `POST /conversations` binds `userId` from authenticated context; validates request body is a non-null object (returns 400 on invalid payloads)
- `GET /conversations` scopes listing to current user
- `POST /conversations/:id/messages` and `DELETE /conversations/:id` verify ownership, return 403 on mismatch
- Backward-compatible: requests without user context and conversations created without a `userId` remain accessible under existing behavior

### Enhanced tool-call loop

- `ChatWithToolsOptions.onToolError` callback: return `'continue'` or `'abort'` per tool failure
- Error tracking across iterations with `toolCallId`-based matching (not index)
- Distinct log messages for user-driven abort (`onToolError` → `'abort'`) vs max-iterations exhaustion
- New `streamChatWithTools()`: streaming tool-call loop yielding SSE events, resolving intermediate tool calls server-side without double model invocation on the final round

```typescript
const result = await ai.chatWithTools(messages, {
  maxIterations: 5,
  onToolError: (toolCall, error) => {
    logger.error(`Tool ${toolCall.name} failed: ${error}`);
    return toolCall.name === 'critical_tool' ? 'abort' : 'continue';
  },
});
```

### Tests

28 new tests: 7 auth metadata, 11 ownership enforcement (including body validation), 6 tool-call error handling, 4 streaming tool loop. All 158 service-ai tests and 6773 spec tests pass.
